notes: holdCapacity is what a full-sized storage holds. A smaller storage holds a permille fraction of it, which is one number per storage instead of a table revisited every time an item is added. workpiece is required on every item: true marks an intermediate that is never in Resource Storage and is accepted only by the buffer of a facility whose type has a schematic making or consuming it (D2, K3). It is required rather than defaulted so that a new intermediate is never made storable by an author forgetting it. No shipped item is a workpiece.

items.label: Matter Mix
items.notes: What missions recover: one bulk material with a composition profile, rather than a dozen ores. GDD 5.8 - it is what makes a reactor's processing mode a decision instead of a formality.

items.label: Hydrogen
items.notes: What the emergency extractor gathers, and the only material the vessel can make without a mission.

items.label: Technical Materials
items.notes: The reactors' standardized outputs. Rare Metals, Chemical Feedstock and Phase Materials are named by the GDD and absent here: no schematic on this vessel consumes them, and an item nothing produces or consumes is a row of zeroes on every storage panel.

items.label: Mission Dock Construction Unit
items.notes: One whole unit is 1000 milli-units. Commissioning consumes exactly one from a dock's local storage. Not a fitted module and not a socket — an ordinary stored item until upgrade sockets exist. 80000 is chosen so a whole unit is half a facility buffer, not all of it: at 25 permille a buffer holds 2000, and a factory set up for assemble_dock_unit reserves one run's output against delivery, so at 40000 that reservation was the entire buffer and the factory making the unit could never be fed its next 400 basic_metals. Half leaves room for the inputs of the thing being reserved for.

items.label: Matter Reactor Construction Unit
items.notes: Same whole-unit and buffer-room rules as mission_dock_construction_unit. Commissions an unbuilt Matter Reactor slot.

items.label: Factory Construction Unit
items.notes: Same whole-unit and buffer-room rules as mission_dock_construction_unit. Commissions an unbuilt Factory slot.
